description: Chữ bị ăn mòn dần theo một vân nhiễu cố định, mép các lỗ cháy màu nhấn, cho tới khi biến mất hẳn.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-noise-dissolve-out, written here): Fixed noise mask on the text: fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.8, 2 octaves, seed 3 (canvas demo: 0.6 × value noise at 0.09/px + 0.4 per-cell hash, 2 px cells). A threshold rises linearly over 1.2 s (demo 1.0–2.2 s, −0.06 → 1.04; recipe brightness +100 → −100) and every cell whose noise is below it is cut out; cells within 0.07 above the threshold are painted accent as a thin burning rim. Loop: text fades back 2.6–3.1 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: duration (1.2 s) · scale: cỡ hạt nhiễu (baseFrequency 0.8) · seed (3) · rim: viền cháy màu nhấn (bật). A fixed noise mask: cells under the rising threshold are cut, those just above it burn in the accent colour.
